meta.title: Villa Gaia | Apartments with pool in Malcesine, Lake Garda
meta.description: Three holiday apartments with a pool, garden and private parking in Malcesine on Lake Garda. 300 metres from the lake, in a quiet olive grove, 1 km from the old town. Book direct with us.

villa.title: Among the olive trees, a short walk from the lake.
villa.text: Villa Gaia is a small villa in a quiet part of Malcesine, in the middle of an olive grove. The lake and the beach are about 300 metres away, the old town about 1 km along a pedestrian path. The owner looks after the apartments personally.
features: Pool with sun loungers and parasols
